rulegen.title: Windows EventLog Service Disabled via Registry

rows.rule_yaml:
title: Windows EventLog Service Disabled via Registry
id: bfa21068-559a-58fa-a946-36a0372122dc
status: experimental
description: Detects modification of the Windows EventLog service Start registry value
  to 4 (disabled), which impairs defenses by disabling event logging. This is a technique
  used by attackers to evade detection by preventing security events from being recorded.
author: Sentinel Loop rule_gen v0
date: '2026-10-02'
tags:
- attack.t1685.001
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1:
    TargetObject|endswith:
    - System\CurrentControlSet\Services\EventLog\Start
    Details|contains:
    - DWORD (0x00000004)
  condition: 1 of selection*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative action to disable EventLog service (rare)
level: high

rulegen.title: MSBuild Execution of Project File from Tasks Folder

rows.rule_yaml:
title: MSBuild Execution of Project File from Tasks Folder
id: 181069b1-c8a4-5db1-aa9d-e68795cb18ad
status: experimental
description: Detects MSBuild.exe executing a project file located in the Windows Tasks
  folder (C:/Windows/Tasks or C:/Windows/System32/Tasks). This folder is globally
  writable and commonly abused for defense evasion and execution via inline tasks
  (T1127.001).
author: Sentinel Loop rule_gen v0
date: '2026-10-02'
tags:
- attack.t1127.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1:
    Image|endswith:
    - MSBuild.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
    - Tasks
  condition: 1 of selection*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate build scripts referencing project files in Tasks folder (unlikely)
level: high

rulegen.title: Suspicious Desktop Executable Spawning Cmd to Execute Another Desktop Binary

rows.rule_yaml:
title: Suspicious Desktop Executable Spawning Cmd to Execute Another Desktop Binary
id: aa359567-e160-5c86-ae1d-f3a7a83275e0
status: experimental
description: Detects a non-standard executable in a user Desktop folder spawning cmd.exe
  to execute another executable from Desktop, often with network arguments indicating
  malicious payload execution.
author: Sentinel Loop rule_gen v0
date: '2026-10-02'
tags:
- attack.t1059.003
- attack.t1204.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1:
    ParentImage|contains:
    - Desktop
    Image|endswith:
    - cmd.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
    - /c
    - Desktop
    - .exe
  condition: 1 of selection*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate software installers or updaters running from Desktop
level: high
